title: App demo from three generated screens
technique: reference images: three UI mockups in one clip
style: Clean mobile UI mockup, light theme, rounded cards, one accent color #2E7D5B, realistic iPhone-style frame, plain background.

keyframes.prompt: Screen 1 of a habit-tracking app: a greeting at the top and a list of five habits with circular progress rings. 9:16 composition.
Screen 2 of the same habit-tracking app: a monthly calendar heatmap in the accent green with a streak counter. 9:16 composition.
Screen 3 of the same habit-tracking app: a celebration card for a 30-day streak with confetti. 9:16 composition.

shots.video_prompt: A hand holds a phone against a soft pastel background and swipes through the app: it starts on the screen in @Image 1, swipes to @Image 2, then taps to reveal @Image 3 as confetti bursts. Smooth, bright, upbeat. Light UI taps and a short cheerful synth jingle.
